reason: An empty duplicate: its spellings (Kamara, Camara), countries (LBR, SLE) and peoples (Vai, Malinké, Kono) were already PAT_CAMARA's, and its only sources were the candidate-queue stub and internal notes.
Darboe is the Gambian spelling of the Dabo clan name. Folded in: the spelling Darboe (GMB, candidate queue). Its Malinké and Gambia links were already the keeper's, with better sources.
Fofanah is the Sierra Leone spelling of Fofana. Folded in: the spelling Fofanah and Sierra Leone as a country (both from the candidate queue).

Youssouf is a form of the personal name Yusuf (Joseph of the Quran); Yusuf has the best sources. Folded in: its two written name-history accounts (meaning, after Behind the Name; Omar Ahmed Youssouf, Présidence de Djibouti 2017), the spellings Youssouf and Yousouf (TCD, DJI, COM), the Somali and Comorian links, the bearer Omar Ahmed Youssouf, its origin claims and its four sources.
Youssef is a transcription of the Arabic Yusuf. Folded in: the spelling Youssef (EGY), the Arabs of Africa and Egypt links, and its Behind the Name origin claim and source.
Osman (and Othman) are forms of the personal name Ousmane, the third caliph's. Folded in: the spellings Osman and Othman and Sudan as a country (candidate queue).

Ally is a variant of Ali (Dictionary of American Family Names). Folded in: the spelling Ally and Tanzania (Office of the Solicitor General), the supposed Swahili link, the DAFN claim and its two sources.
Benali is Ben Ali with the space removed by the civil registry. Folded in: Tunisia as a country for both spellings and the Insaniyat review of Chabchoub (2017), which records that change.

Aboubakar and Aboubacar are the Cameroonian forms of Abubakar. Folded in: the spellings Aboubakar and Aboubacar (CMR), the Fula link, Cameroon, the Ryan and Gabana-Bello claim and the Gabana and Bello (2025) source. Ryan (1981) was already cited by the keeper under another key.
Ceesay is the Gambian spelling of Cissé. Folded in: the spelling Ceesay and Gambia as a country (candidate queue).
Sesay is the Sierra Leone spelling of Cissé. Folded in: the spelling Sesay and Sierra Leone as a country (candidate queue).
